title: Welcome to your research desk
text: Welcome to Luggage Atlas. In about two minutes, here’s how to compare products, build a cost scenario, and export your shortlist.

title: Explore the product
text: Start with the weekly dashboard for dated launches. Open Outside and Inside for product photos, or Style and Shoppers to understand the design appeal.

title: Choose exact offers
text: Open Compare and Cost. Search a brand or model, then select up to four priced offers. Your selections stay saved as you search.

title: Compare the details
text: Compare the named products, retail prices, features and supplier evidence side by side. Photo references may differ from the exact priced model or color.

title: Build a cost scenario
text: Enter your own assumptions in U.S. dollars: F O B, freight, duty allowance, and other unit costs. Set planned retail and quantity. Landed cost and gross margin update automatically. Blank costs stay unknown.

title: Keep currencies clear
text: For a non-dollar offer, enter your own exchange rate to show its retail price in dollars. Cost assumptions are planning inputs, not supplier quotes or verified tariff rates.

title: Export your shortlist
text: Choose Export Selected CSV. Your download includes only selected offers, with cost inputs, calculations, photo links and source links. Open it in Excel. CSV files contain image links, not embedded photos.

title: Check the sourcing evidence
text: In Suppliers and Factories, search a brand and expand Verify with Sources. Review the company name, dated evidence and model limitations. You’re ready to compare, cost and share.

title: Innovation, trends & technology
text: Open Innovation and Tech to see the mechanism behind a feature, the travel problem it solves, and brands using it. Review trend evidence and Open Story development ideas before comparing the available offers.
